title: Manage API keys
caption: Owners and admins of an active OTA; full keys are shown once.

steps.title: List
steps.expect: Prefix, last4, kind, environment, scopes, origins, last use; never the key.

steps.title: Create
steps.body: `POST …/api-keys {name, kind: publishable|secret, environment: test, allowedOrigins?, scopes?}`.
steps.expect: `201` with the full key, `Cache-Control: no-store`. Over `plans.limits.apiKeys` → `422 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED`; live key before go-live → `422 LIVE_MODE_NOT_ENABLED`; live secret key needs a step-up.

steps.title: Roll
steps.expect: New key shown once; old key gets `expires_at`.

steps.title: Revoke
steps.expect: `revoked_at` set; the OTA API refuses the key within 60 s; a second revoke `409 CONFLICT` (revoked).

steps.title: Usage
steps.body: Use the key against the OTA API, wait for `api_keys.flush_usage` (every 5 min).
